description: API rate limiting implementation - Add request rate limiting middleware to FastAPI application to prevent abuse. Implement per-endpoint rate limits using slowapi library with Redis backend for distributed rate limiting across workers.
steps: Add slowapi==0.1.9 and limits==3.7.0 to backend/requirements.txt
Create backend/app/core/rate_limiter.py implementing rate limiter with Redis storage using existing REDIS_URL from settings
Create rate limit configuration in backend/app/core/config.py: Add RATE_LIMIT_DISCOVERY (10/minute), RATE_LIMIT_AI_AGENTS (20/minute), RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT (60/minute)
Apply rate limiting middleware to FastAPI app in backend/main.py using SlowAPI, configure Redis backend

Add rate limit decorators to high-cost endpoints in backend/app/api/v1/discovery.py (10 requests per minute), backend/app/api/v1/agents.py (20 requests per minute), backend/app/api/v1/outreach.py (10 requests per minute)
Add rate limit exceeded exception handler in backend/main.py returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After header
Create tests in backend/tests/test_rate_limiting.py covering: exceeding limits returns 429, Retry-After header present, different limits per endpoint, Redis storage works
Document rate limits in backend/docs/API_RATE_LIMITS.md with table showing endpoint → limit mapping
acceptance_criteria: slowapi library integrated with Redis storage backend
Discovery endpoints limited to 10 requests per minute per IP
AI agent endpoints limited to 20 requests per minute per IP
All other endpoints limited to 60 requests per minute per IP
HTTP 429 returned when limit exceeded with Retry-After header
Rate limit state persisted in Redis (survives backend restart)
New test file test_rate_limiting.py with 5+ test cases all passing
verification: python backend/main.py (starts without errors, rate limiter initialized)
Check Redis: docker exec -it crm_leads_redis redis-cli KEYS '*rate*' (shows rate limit keys)
